why: About 12.5% of the 500 answers (~62) stay in the plain-base register, which is short and wrong about half the time (~31 wrong, ~85% of them under 2,000 tokens, so ~26), and the RL-like majority adds almost no quick wrong answers (~3); the total is about twice the cued base's 13.
The top-8 edit is a weak dose of RL's own policy, which cut hard328 cue cap hits from 77 to 46 at 1x; doubling the dose moves it further toward RL's 20, so about 32.
A stronger dose of the RL policy along the same 8 directions moves hard328 cue accuracy from 192 at 1x toward RL's 206, mostly by turning cap hits into finished answers.
